summary: Busy arterial kerb with no parked cars, houses and flats close behind.

best_section.where: Sir Fred Schonell Drive north kerb, beside the dense tree belt

drivers.seclusion: Homes 22 m and 34 m away mid-section, and 1-8 m at both ends; overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb abuts a narrow verge and trees; no pull-off beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-lane arterial with centre line; no cars parked along it.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on this side; signs show 2P, No Stopping peak hours and No Stopping Any Time.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the best section, mostly shaded.
